caption: The drawing depicts a single, realistic candlestick rendered in grayscale pencil or graphite. The candlestick is centrally positioned on the page and has a symmetrical, ornate design. Its base is wide and elaborately shaped with a multi-tiered, angular form, featuring a series of curved, stepped ridges. The stem of the candlestick is slender, with distinct bulges and tapering sections as it rises, and it transitions into a socket at the top, intended to hold a candle. Shading and highlights are used throughout to give the impression of a reflective metallic surface. The background is plain and unadorned, and the entire drawing appears on off-white or slightly yellowed paper. There is a small, unobtrusive signature in the lower-left corner reading “L. BROZOFF.”
title: Silver Candlestick
